question: ap1
prompt:
Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Clonal heritability of AP-1 activity
ideas.description: Expand single-cell-derived clones carrying an AP-1 transcriptional reporter and heritable barcodes, then compare between-clone versus within-clone variance in reporter level and AP-1 motif accessibility. Fit decay of clonal correlation versus division number to estimate a memory half-life and test it against protein-dilution expectations.

ideas.title: Pulse-chase perturbation with washout
ideas.description: Transiently induce AP-1 with a degron-tagged or optogenetic FOS/JUN construct (or suppress it with A-FOS), then withdraw the perturbation and track accessibility, expression, and phenotype for weeks. A state that outlives the pulse argues AP-1 writes memory; collapse on washout argues it only maintains an ongoing state.

ideas.title: Acute AP-1 removal in cells that already remember
ideas.description: Apply rapid degradation of AP-1 subunits in cells already in a primed state, such as drug-tolerant persisters or previously stimulated cells. Ask whether memory-associated enhancer accessibility, H3K27ac, and the enhanced recall response are lost, separating continuous occupancy from a self-sustaining chromatin mark.

ideas.title: Re-stimulation kinetics as the functional readout
ideas.description: Prime cells, allow the primary response to resolve, then re-stimulate and measure response latency, amplitude, and responding-cell fraction by live imaging or time-resolved sequencing. Memory predicts faster or larger secondary induction specifically at AP-1-bound loci, which should vanish when AP-1 sites are mutated.

ideas.title: Motif-resolution causal mapping at candidate memory enhancers
ideas.description: Use base or prime editing to disrupt individual AP-1 motifs at enhancers that remain open after the signal ends, with scrambled and neighboring-motif controls. If these motifs store the memory, editing should abolish retained accessibility and the primed response while leaving the acute primary response intact.
